rows.one_line: 高盛预计投资者将关注 Rubin 在 2026 年下半年及 2027 年的爬坡情况，以及其在新客户群中的采用证据。
rows.reason: The analyst says adoption evidence in new customer cohorts will be a focus; this is a monitoring point, not evidence that such deployments have occurred.

rows.quote: Fourth, it expects attention on CPU demand driven by agentic AI, with Nvidia's CPU-only racks expected to begin shipping in the second half.
rows.one_line: Goldman Sachs预计投资者将关注由智能体AI驱动的CPU需求，NVIDIA纯CPU机架预计于2026年下半年开始出货。
rows.reason: The analyst expects NVIDIA CPU-only racks to begin shipping in 2H; this is a forecast, not an actual shipment or realized revenue.

rows.quote: In June 2026, CoreWeave completed the industry-first bring-up and validation of NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72.
rows.one_line: CoreWeave称其于2026年6月完成NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72的bring-up和验证。
rows.reason: CoreWeave reports completing Vera Rubin NVL72 bring-up and validation, an actual readiness milestone, though not proof of commercial deployment or shipments.

rows.quote: With Vera Rubin NVL72, CoreWeave shared the first measured performance results: up to 10x more tokens per second per megawatt than NVIDIA GB200 NVL72.
rows.one_line: CoreWeave公布称，Vera Rubin NVL72每兆瓦每秒生成的token数最高可达NVIDIA GB200 NVL72的10倍。
rows.reason: CoreWeave reports measured Vera Rubin performance results after validation, an actual technical result that may support adoption but does not establish sales or revenue.

rows.quote: At the system level, modular cable-free trays make assembly up to 90x faster than Blackwell and simplifies serviceability, and software-defined NVLink routing reroutes around faults to keep operation continuous with less maintenance overhead.
rows.one_line: CoreWeave称，Vera Rubin的模块化无缆托盘使系统组装速度最高达到Blackwell的90倍，并可通过软件定义的NVLink路由绕开故障。
rows.reason: CoreWeave reports system assembly and fault-routing results, an actual technical/operational result that may aid deployment, but not proof of shipments or revenue.
